title: Michael Burry’s Bearish Bet Against Nebius Stock Sends a Warning Message to AI Bulls
excerpt: Michael Burry doubled down on his Nebius short right after blowout earnings. Here's what his bet says about the AI infrastructure boom.
content_html:
Nebius Group (NBIS) recently posted one of the best quarters any AI cloud company has reported all year. Revenue more than quintupled, and the tech stock surged over 34% in a single trading session, following its Q2 results.

However, Michael Burry remains bearish on NBIS stock.

The investor, famous for calling the 2008 housing crash, added to his short position in Nebius the same day the numbers came out. Burry's reasoning has less to do with Nebius itself than with what he thinks the whole AI buildout looks like right now.

Nebius Delivers a Blowout Quarter

Nebius, the Amsterdam-based, Nvidia-powered (NVDA) AI cloud provider that spun out of the Russian internet company Yandex, reported Q2 revenue of $582 million, up 454% year-over-year (YoY). By comparison, Wall Street forecast revenue of $572.75 million in Q2.

The company's core AI cloud segment grew even faster, jumping 514% to $575 million, and its annualized run rate revenue topped $3 billion by the end of June, up from $1.9 billion in Q1. 

Nebius closed four contracts averaging more than $1 billion each during the quarter, with customers including Reflection, Cohere, a major U.S. lab, and a large U.S. quant trading firm. 

About 70% of deals signed in the quarter included upfront prepayments covering 50% to 60% of the related buildout costs. Adjusted EBITDA margin for the AI cloud unit reached 50%, up from 45% the prior quarter.

The company ended June with $8 billion in cash and reaffirmed its full-year guidance, including capital spending of $20 billion to $25 billion.

Burry Doubled Down Short Position

Burry first disclosed his Nebius short on Aug. 6 at around $212 per share, a position he said was even larger than his short against Oracle (ORCL), placed around the same time. Less than a week later, after Nebius posted results that beat expectations across the board and the stock jumped to around $260, Burry added to the short.

According to Investing.com:

  • In a Substack post the same day, Burry described Nebius as an example of what the peak of a boom looks like.

  • He also raised short positions in Micron (MU) and Oracle.

  • He already holds shorts against Nvidia, Palantir (PLTR), Applied Materials (AMAT), and Caterpillar (CAT), with Nvidia tied to his broader worries about circular financing arrangements across the AI supply chain.

Nebius 季度业绩井喷

Nebius 是一家总部位于阿姆斯特丹、由 Nvidia 支持 (NVDA) 的人工智能云提供商，从俄罗斯互联网公司 Yandex 中分离出来，该公司报告第二季度收入为 5.82 亿美元，同比增长 454%。 相比之下，华尔街预测第二季度营收为 5.7275 亿美元。

该公司的核心人工智能云业务增长更快，增长了 514%，达到 5.75 亿美元，截至 6 月底，其年化运行率收入超过 30 亿美元，高于第一季度的 19 亿美元。

Nebius 在本季度签署了四份合同，平均每份价值超过 10 亿美元，客户包括 Reflection、Cohere、一家美国大型实验室和一家大型美国量化交易公司。

本季度签署的交易中约 70% 包括预付款，占相关扩建成本的 50% 至 60%。 AI 云部门调整后 EBITDA 利润率达到 50%，高于上一季度的 45%。

截至 6 月，该公司拥有 80 亿美元现金，并重申了全年指引，包括 200 亿至 250 亿美元的资本支出。

伯里加倍空头头寸

Burry 于 8 月 6 日首次以每股 212 美元左右的价格披露了他的 Nebius 空头头寸，他表示这一头寸甚至比他大约在同一时间针对甲骨文 (ORCL) 的空头头寸还要大。 不到一周后，Nebius 公布的业绩全面超出预期，股价跃升至 260 美元左右，之后 Burry 又增加了空头头寸。

据 Investing.com 报道：

  • 在同一天的 Substack 帖子中，伯里将 Nebius 描述为繁荣顶峰的一个例子。
  • 他还增持了美光科技（MU）和甲骨文的空头头寸。
  • 他已经持有英伟达、Palantir (PLTR)、应用材料公司 (AMAT) 和卡特彼勒 (CAT) 的空头头寸，英伟达与他对整个人工智能供应链循环融资安排的更广泛担忧有关。
